headline: Google further buries search results under AI mode
summary: Google is automatically expanding its AI search summaries. This pushes traditional search links much further down the results page. The change makes it harder to find standard search results.

headline: Xbox CEO calls Project Helix a ‘family of devices’
summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma clarified Project Helix's scope. It's now referred to as a 'family' of devices, not a singular console. Microsoft is actively developing a 'great next generation' of hardware.

headline: Save hundreds on a TCL mini-LED TV with quantum dots and high refresh rate
summary: The TCL QM7L mini-LED TV is currently on sale for hundreds off. Discounts include $200 off the 55-inch model, now $797.99. These TVs boast quantum dots and a high refresh rate.

headline: Trump’s EPA wants to let data centers hide their air pollution
summary: The EPA proposes changes to rules for data center air pollution. New plans would remove public notice requirements for certain industrial sites. This makes it harder for communities to comment on pollution.

headline: Join Us: Watch 11 Minutes of Exclusive Gameplay from the Upcoming Cult Simulator | gamescom 2026
summary: Wolf Haus Games revealed 11 minutes of gameplay for 'Join Us'. The cult simulator is confirmed for a PS5 release. Its trailer features real-life former cult members.

headline: Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Will Send You On a Chilly Loot Grind | gamescom 2026
summary: Dragon's Dogma 2's 'Dark Arisen' expansion adds a new, chilly region. It features clever winter weather effects and a fresh loot grind. Players will encounter a dragon that vomits zombies.

headline: The Pokémon Company Looks to Smart Device Integrations as Future Targets
summary: The Pokémon Company is exploring smart device integrations. CEO Tsunekazu Ishihara hinted at future plans involving wearable technology. This direction was discussed at the inaugural PokémonXP event.

headline: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil on Track to Have Biggest Opening Weekend of Any RE Movie in History
summary: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' movie is poised for a record-breaking opening. It's projected to have the most profitable opening weekend for any RE film. The movie adapts Capcom's popular horror franchise.

headline: 97-year-old woman rescued after Nepali floods looked like 'a warrior'
summary: A 97-year-old woman, Guna Maya Bohara, survived devastating flash floods in Nepal. She was dramatically rescued using an excavator. Witnesses described her incredible resilience as 'a warrior'.

headline: Christian festival 'devastated' as man dies after sign falls
summary: A man tragically died after a sign fell at the Big Church Festival. At least six other people sustained injuries in the incident. The Christian festival expressed deep devastation over the tragedy.

headline: Burnham's summer tour is over - now he has to prove himself in Parliament
summary: Prime Minister Burnham's summer tour has concluded. He now faces intense scrutiny from MPs in Parliament. Lawmakers will get their chance to question him thoroughly.

headline: Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy
summary: A woman who rented homes to 9/11 hijackers speaks out publicly for the first time. She revealed connections between the hijackers and an alleged Saudi spy. Her exclusive story was shared with the BBC.
